def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    t = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    num = 0
    for i in range(n):
        count = 0
        last = a[i] + t
        for j in range(i, n):
            if a[i] <= a[j] <= last:
                count += 1
        if count > num:
            num = count
    print(num)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
